children: was trading higher after Piper Sandler initiated coverage of the stock with an Overweight rating and $38 price target.
Shares were 1.56% higher at $33.95 during afternoon trading on Thursday.

"Following several years of tech investments and the completion of the company's largest acquisition in its history (closed in 3Q25), we believe CCNE is positioned to realize scale efficiencies, drive positive operating leverage, and deliver more consistent profitability (PSCe ROA = 1.3% in 2026 & 2027) near peer levels," said analyst Adam Kroll.

"We believe CCNE's improving and more consistent profitability should support a narrowing of shares' valuation discount (8.9x our 2027E EPS vs. 10.5x) over time, while excess capital deployment via buybacks or sub debt / preferred redemption provides a potential positive catalyst over the N-T," said Kroll.
